name: DeadZone Lite
description: Base modified ROM style — all automatic ROM mods run here. Stable/Legend/Ninja inherit Lite.

mods.name: Signature Verification Bypass
mods.description: Bypasses APK signature verification on A14/A15/A16 via smali patches to ApkSigningBlockUtils, StrictJarVerifier, SigningDetails, and related classes

mods.name: invoke-custom handling
mods.description: Handles invoke-custom smali instructions in framework — replaces equals/hashCode/toString bodies that contain invoke-custom with safe stubs

mods.name: fix bootloop A15
mods.description: Fixes A15 bootloop caused by specific smali files across framework_unpacked, services_unpacked, and miui_services_unpacked

mods.name: miui-services CN/Global Build flag patches
mods.description: Patches CN/Global Build flags in miui-services smali: replaces IS_INTERNATIONAL_BUILD/IS_GLOBAL_BUILD with IS_MIUI, injects const/4 forcing values, and adds const/4 v0,0x0 above PolicyManager CN_MODEL sput

mods.name: Lite APK/App Patches
mods.description: Applies APK-level patches: PowerKeeper CN/global Build flags + MilletConfig const/4 + isGmsControlEnabled→false; Provision MEZO branding strings; MiuiSystemUI Hide 4G/Show VoLTE for OS2/3 CN ROMs

mods.name: Kousei / Kaorios Toolbox
mods.description: Kaorios Toolbox V2.0.4 integration: APK install, privapp XML, build.prop, classes.dex injection, and V2.0.3+ smali hooks

mods.name: OS1 Mods
mods.description: OS1 (HyperOS 1 / MIUI) specific ROM mods — conditional on rom_os=OS1

mods.name: OS2 Mods
mods.description: OS2 (HyperOS 2) specific ROM mods — conditional on rom_os=OS2

mods.name: OS3 Mods
mods.description: OS3 (HyperOS 3) specific ROM mods — conditional on rom_os=OS3

mods.name: Universal Mods
mods.description: Universal ROM mods applied to all devices and all OS versions

mods.name: UpdateFile Mods
mods.description: UpdateFile ROM mods (device patches, region fixes, theme, fonts). Legacy overlapping modules inside UpdateFile/ are gated by ENABLE_LEGACY_DEADZONE_FRAMEWORK_PATCHER, ENABLE_LEGACY_DEADZONE_JARMODS, ENABLE_LEGACY_DEADZONE_KAORIOS_TOOLBOX — all default false when ENABLE_DEADZONE_PACKAGE_PATCHES=true.

mods.name: POCO Launcher to MiuiHome Spoofing
mods.description: Detects POCO brand ROM via ro.product.vendor.brand=POCO in vendor/odm prop files and replaces the value with Redmi so MiuiHome launcher loads instead of POCO Launcher. Skipped automatically on non-POCO ROMs.

mods.name: product/data-app → product/app Migration
mods.description: Moves apps from product/data-app/ into product/app/ so they are treated as preinstalled system apps instead of user-data apps. Skipped automatically when product/data-app/ is absent.
